LEAD23-02-001 is Accepted as LEAD-2023-0003: on Feb. 2 Attorney General Gali Baharav-Miara formally applied Netanyahu's conflict-of-interest restrictions to the judicial-overhaul initiatives and required him to refrain from direct or indirect involvement because of a reasonable concern tied to his ongoing criminal trial. The record preserves that the specific restriction did not bar Justice Minister Yariv Levin or Constitution Committee chair Simcha Rothman from advancing the overhaul, and preserves Netanyahu/coalition objections. This is recorded as a formal attorney-general conflict-of-interest opinion, not as a criminal finding or proof of personal motive. Canonical Sheet, source corroboration and Notion publication are verified; the direct gov.il letter/exact original media was not recovered and no substitute image was used.
